title: Google Calendar Writer Access Error
html:
This tutorial will show you to connect your Google calendar to your KenjiAI calendar if you are receiving the following error: 


You need to have writer access to sync appointments to the selected Google Calendar. Please check with the Google Calendar owner in case syncing is required.


For Group Calendar:

For Unassigned Calendar:


For Group Calendar:




For Unassigned Calendar:



Step 1:


The owner of the Google calendar needs to be logged into Google and go to calendar.google.com


Step 2:

Hover over the desired calendar then click the three-dot icon and select "Settings And Sharing"



Step 3: 


Scroll down to "Share with specific people" > Click "Add People" and add the email address of the Google Account that is synced in KenjiAI > set the Permissions to "Make changes to events" > click Send to save



The Google calendar should now be in sync with KenjiAI
